players.bio: Christopher Francis Hogg (born 12 March 1985) is an English former footballer who is currently the manager of EFL League One club Northampton Town. Hogg started his career with the York City youth system in 1997, captaining England at under-15 level. He signed for the FA Premier League team Ipswich Town for a compensation fee of £150,000 in June 2001.

Connor Lemonheigh-Evans (born 24 January 1997) is a Welsh footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Northampton Town . He is a Wales under-21 international. He started his career at Bristol City and had loans at Bath City and Torquay United, before joining Torquay United for an undisclosed fee in August 2020. Early career Lemonheigh-Evans was born in Swansea.
Conor McCarthy (born 11 April 1998) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. He has previously played for Cork City and St Mirren.

Elliott Ricardo Wignal-List (born 12 May 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League two club Northampton Town. List signed a one-year professional contract with Gillingham in May 2015, following his release from the Crystal Palace youth set-up. He made his League One debut for the "Gills" on 26 December 2015,
Elliott Jordan Moore (born 16 March 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender.
Harvey Read Saunders (born 20 July 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a Centre-Forward.
Jack Stephen Burroughs (born 21 March 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender Northampton Town .
Jack Perkins (born 26 October 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL League Two club Northampton Town, as a midfielder.

James Michael Dadge (born 18 October 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Northampton Town. Career A product of the Northampton Town academy, Dadge spent time on loan with St Ives Town, Harborough Town and Banbury United across the 2022–23 and 2023–24 seasons.
James Maxwell is a 24-year-old professional Scottish footballer who plays as a left-back for Northampton Town F.C.

Janoi Denzil Naieme Donacien (born 3 November 1993) is a Saint Lucian professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. , and represents the Saint Lucia national team. A versatile player, he is capable of playing at full-back and centre-back. Born in Saint Lucia, Donacien moved to England at the age of eight.

Joe Wormleighton is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or wing-back for EFL League Two club Northampton Town F.C.. Born in Leicester, the 22-year-old developer came through the academy at Leicester City, where he also captained the Under-21 side.

Jonathan Neil Guthrie (born 29 July 1992) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. He began his career with Pewsey Vale and has also played for Crewe Alexandra, Leek Town, Walsall and Livingston.

Joe O'Brien-Whitmarsh is a 21-year-old Irish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Northampton Town in EFL League Two. Known for his technical ability and vision, he signed a three-year contract with Northampton Town in August 2026 after moving from Southampton for an undisclosed fee.
Joshua Alan Powell (born 9 January 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL League Two club Northampton Town on loan from Premier League club Nottingham Forest.

Kyle Hakeem Edwards is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or left winger for EFL League One club Northampton Town F.C. Edwards began his career with West Bromwich Albion, joining the club's academy at the age of six. He made his senior professional debut in September 2017 while on loan at EFL League Two side Exeter City.

Lee Evans is a 32-year-old Welsh professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Northampton Town F.C.. and the Wales national football team. Having been released by Bristol Rovers as a 15-year-old, Evans began his professional career at his hometown club Newport County, for whom he made his senior debut aged 17 on 20 March 2012
Liam Darren Shaw (born 12 March 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Northampton Town.
Logan Briggs is a 21-year-old Welsh youth international footballer who plays as a versatile attacking midfielder for EFL League Two club Northampton Town, on loan from Leicester City.

Matty Warhurst is a 20-year-old English professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. Known as a prolific academy goalscorer and a traditional "poacher" in the box, he joined Northampton Town permanently in July 2026 on a three-year deal from Manchester City.
Max Dyche (born 22 February 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Northampton Town.
Nathaniel Opoku (born 22 July 2001) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Northampton Town

Owen Dale is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. Signed from Blackpool in February 2024, he previously played over 100 games for Crewe Alexandra and had loan spells at Witton Albion, Altrincham, Blackpool and Portsmouth.

Ross Alan Richard Frank Fitzsimons (born 28 May 1994) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Northampton Town . He has been spent time on the books at Crystal Palace, Bolton Wanderers, Braintree Town, Chelmsford City and Notts County, and spent time on loan at Harrow Borough, Hendon, Havant & Waterlooville, Farnborough and Bishop's Stortford.

Samuel Rory Chambers is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League Two club Northampton Town on loan from Premier League club Leeds United. He is a Scotland Under 19 international.

Samuel Tobias Hoskins (born 4 February 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Northampton Town. Hoskins was born in Dorchester, Dorset and began his career at Southampton, joining the club as a trainee in 2005; signing his first professional contract six years later.

Tyrese Momodu Fornah (born 11 September 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL League Two club Northampton Town. Born in England, he plays for the Sierra Leone national team. Fornah graduated for the academy at Nottingham Forest, but struggled to break into the first team and had loan spells at Casa Pia, Plymouth Argyle, Shrewsbury Town and Reading.

Zach Jeacock is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper. He is currently playing for EFL League Two club Northampton Town, where he serves as the team's starting number one while on a season-long loan from EFL Championship side Lincoln City.
